name: vgae
smoke: export TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL=2 OMP_NUM_THREADS=2; mkdir -p out; cd gae; for ds in cora citeseer; do PYTHONPATH=/work python train.py --model gcn_vae --dataset $ds --features 1 > ../out/vgae_$ds.log 2>&1 & PYTHONPATH=/work python train.py --model gcn_ae --dataset $ds --features 1 > ../out/gae_$ds.log 2>&1 & wait; done; cd ..; bash gf_harness/emit.sh
